notes.title: Updated Limited Demo 1.1 for SEAGO
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43319597/29dbe7d4111b7246dabfb1030a75e2162f967329.png[/img]
We are participating in SEAGO, with it we updated limited demo will be accessible until the end of[url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/25278687-Virtual-SEA-Games-from-SEAsia/sale/seago2023] SEAGO[/url] in January 8th,
give it a try to the Demo before SEAGO ended, and please sent us your feedback it is very helpful to us.
[h1]Change log:[/h1]
Based on several feedback we acquired, we have made several changes to the demo and the game overall, our changes are as follow;
--> Fixed where in some case a character/enemy will get seemingly unlimited turns
--> Simplifies more icon-oriented skill descriptions
--> Changing several icon to better represent what it actually means
--> Replaces and balances some other skills
--> Fixed bugs on row formations
--> Added credits on the ending
--> Decorated the dungeon even more
--> Added the triangle of advantage Hud
--> Adjusted the battle Hud colours and positioning
--> Changed Shuilong sprite to suit in game battler
--> Small optimizations
--> Can now escape normal battles
--> Added several animations
